2. 3. 12. 6. 

19. Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati. katamehi dvīhi: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā appasādaniye ṭhāne pasādaṃ upadaṃseti. Ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne appāsādaṃ upadaṃseti. Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.112
